name: Utazu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Utazu town emblem in navy: a stylised bird with outstretched angular wings.
history: Municipal flag of Utazu, a town in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 October 1964.

features.role: Utazu town emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched angular wings
